steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with the application name 'InnovateHub' and package name 'com.innovatehubsolutions.app'.

steps.title: Configure Backend API Schema and Logic
steps.description: Set up api_schema.json, declaring no online backend but documenting the client-side 'project_quote' calculation logic.

steps.title: Set up Gradle Build Environment
steps.description: Configure the app's build.gradle file for Java 8 compatibility, SDK versions, and necessary dependencies.

steps.title: Declare Android Manifest
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml, defining the application, main activity, and internet permission (if required for potential image loading, though local drawables are used).

steps.title: Define App Resources (strings.xml, styles.xml)
steps.description: Create string resources for app name, spinner arrays, and define a custom theme for consistent styling.

steps.title: Create Drawable Resources
steps.description: Define XML drawables for card backgrounds and placeholder image references for the UI elements.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout (activity_main.xml)
steps.description: Lay out the primary user interface using a ScrollView and LinearLayout to organize sections like Header, Hero, About, Services, Calculator, Testimonials, Contact, and Footer.

steps.title: Implement Project Quote Calculator UI
steps.description: Integrate UI elements for the calculator: Spinners for service type and complexity, a SeekBar for estimated hours, CheckBoxes for add-ons, and TextViews to display the calculated total and breakdown.

steps.title: Implement Contact Form UI
steps.description: Design a simple contact form with EditText fields for name, email, and project description, a Spinner for project type, and a Button for submission.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java Logic
steps.description: Write Java code for MainActivity to initialize UI components, handle user interactions for the calculator and contact form.

steps.title: Add Quote Calculator Logic in Java
steps.description: Develop the `updateProjectQuote` method within MainActivity to perform the offline calculation based on user inputs from the UI, including parsing spinner values.

steps.title: Integrate Contact Form Simulation Logic
steps.description: Add event listeners and a simple simulation for the contact form submission within MainActivity, displaying a success message locally.

steps.title: Building InnovateHub
steps.description: Assemble the Android application, ensuring all components are correctly integrated and the app builds without errors.
